suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require documented PCOS preceding separately diagnosed endometrial cancer. Treat as population-level association/risk evidence; do not claim individual causation and preserve confounding limitations including BMI. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) and Endometrial Cancer
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
